text: On any set X, set d(x,y)=0 for equal points and 1 otherwise. This defines the discrete metric.

text: On R^2, define d((x,y),(u,v))=|x-u|+|y-v|. Triangle inequalities in each coordinate prove the metric axioms.

text: Starting with [0,1], repeatedly remove the open middle third of every remaining interval. The intersection is the compact Cantor set.

text: Complete Q with its usual metric by taking equivalence classes of Cauchy sequences; equivalent sequences have difference tending to zero. The completion is R.

text: For a unit vector u in R^n, set P(v)=(u dot v)u. Then P^2=P, with image span(u) and kernel u-perpendicular.

text: The n-by-n matrix with ones on the superdiagonal and zeros elsewhere shifts coordinates. Its nth power is zero, but its (n-1)st power is nonzero.

text: For x^2+a*x+b, the matrix [[0,-b],[1,-a]] has characteristic polynomial x^2+a*x+b.
